title: Karel Vanicek

page_data.en:
FORM 3
G 65M 19

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........
S.I, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date August 7, 1939.
Subject (in full) Communication from the British Consulate-General dated
July 20, 1939, concerning Karel Vanicek.
Made by D.S. Pavloff    Forwarded by C. O......

With reference to the attached letter from the
H.B.M. Consulate-General enquiring about Karel Vanicek,
Czechoslovakian, enquiries reveal that according to the
register kept at the local Czechoslovakian Legation
(at present at the German Consulate-General) no person
as named in the communication has ever resided in
Shanghai. The passport mentioned in the letter was
prolonged by the local Czechoslovakian Legation on
July 13, 1939 when it was received by post from Hongkong.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning Mr. Karel Vanicek.

L. S. Pavloff
D. S.

D.C.(Special Branch)

（左侧手写批注：）
232
8/8

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 .........
特别支部分站，
报告
日期：1939年8月7日。
事由（全称）：英国总领事馆1939年7月20日来函，关于卡雷尔·瓦尼切克（Karel Vanicek）。
呈报人：D.S. 帕夫洛夫（Pavloff）    转呈人：C. O......

就附上的英国驻华总领事馆询问捷克人卡雷尔·瓦尼切克（Karel Vanicek）的信件而言，经查证，根据当地捷克斯洛伐克公使馆（现设于德国总领事馆内）保存的登记册，来函中提及姓名之人从未在上海居住。信中提到的护照于1939年7月13日由当地捷克斯洛伐克公使馆延期，当时该护照是从香港通过邮政收到的。
在工部局警务处的档案中，没有任何关于卡雷尔·瓦尼切克先生的记录。

L. S. 帕夫洛夫
D. S.

副督察长（特别支部）

（左侧手写批注：）
232

page_data.en:
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 259. SHANGHAI.

JULY 20th, 1938.

My dear Robertson:

A Czech by the name of KAREL WALTER who
holds a passport issued at the Czechoslovakian
Legation, Shanghai, on July 10th, 1938, is now
in Hongkong. He intends to apply for naturali-
zation as a British subject after the expiry of
the requisite five-year period and in the mean-
while has offered himself for enrolment in the
Hongkong Volunteers.

I should be grateful if you would let me
know if he ever came to the notice of the Police
here or if there is anything known to his detri-
ment.

Yours sincerely,

Deputy Comsr. T. Robertson,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
185 Foochow Road,
Shanghai
page_data.zh:
英国总领事馆，
邮政信箱 259，上海。

1938年7月20日。

亲爱的罗伯逊：

一名名叫卡雷尔·沃尔特（KAREL WALTER）的捷克人，持有1938年7月10日由捷克斯洛伐克驻上海公使馆签发的护照，目前在香港。他打算在满足规定的五年期限后申请归化为英国臣民，同时已报名加入香港义勇军。

如蒙告知此人是否曾进入上海警方的视线，或是否有任何对其不利的记录，我将不胜感激。

此致

敬礼，

T. 罗伯逊 副督察长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路185号，
上海

page_data.en:
August 8 39.

Dear Mr. Burton,

With reference to your letter dated
July 26, 1939, I have to inform you that there
is nothing in Municipal Police records concerning
Karel Vanicek. Enquiries made at the local German
Consulate -General reveal that this name does not
appear on the register of Czechoslovakian citizens
residing in Shanghai formerly kept by the Czecho-
slovakian Legation in Shanghai. The passport
which was renewed on July 13, 1938, was received
by the Czechoslovakian Legation from Hongkong through
the post.

Yours sincerely,

James Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月8日。

亲爱的伯顿先生：

关于您1939年7月26日的来信，特此通知，工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于卡雷尔·瓦尼切克（Karel Vanicek）的记录。向当地德国总领事馆进行的查询显示，该姓名未出现在原由捷克斯洛伐克驻上海公使馆保存的、居住在上海的捷克斯洛伐克公民登记册上。该护照于1938年7月13日获得延期，是捷克斯洛伐克公使馆通过邮政从香港收到的。

此致

敬礼，

詹姆斯·巴顿 先生，
英国驻华总领事馆，
上海。
